title: TypeScript
text: TypeScript is a programming language that extends JavaScript with a static type system. Type annotations are generally removed during compilation, leaving JavaScript for execution.

title: Lazy loading
text: Lazy loading delays loading a resource until it is needed. In JavaScript, dynamic import() returns a promise for a module and allows applications to split code into independently loaded modules.

title: Content delivery network (CDN)
text: A content delivery network distributes content through geographically dispersed servers. Caching resources closer to users can reduce latency and origin traffic. Versioned URLs help prevent stale resource conflicts.

title: Model quantization
text: Quantization represents model weights or activations using lower numerical precision. It can reduce storage and memory usage and sometimes improve inference speed, but may reduce model accuracy. Actual performance depends on hardware and implementation.

title: WebGPU
text: WebGPU provides a browser API for GPU graphics and general-purpose computation. It can accelerate suitably implemented machine-learning workloads. Availability depends on browser and hardware support and a secure context.

title: Photosynthesis
text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants, algae and some bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy. In oxygenic photosynthesis, carbon dioxide and water are used to produce carbohydrates and oxygen is released.

title: Retrieval-augmented generation
text: Retrieval-augmented generation retrieves relevant external information and supplies it to a generative model as context. It can improve access to updated or domain-specific facts, but retrieval and generation can still make mistakes.

title: Naive Bayes classifier
text: A naive Bayes classifier estimates class probabilities using Bayes' theorem and a conditional independence assumption for features. It can be trained from labeled examples and is often used for text classification.
